limitations: Synthetic source and harness CPU included in Windows job accounting, including exited child workers
Resource snapshots every 5 seconds; minimized packaged WebView driven via loopback CDP with no foreground input
Recovery measures complete Core teardown/reopen; process crash correctness is separately tested
No extrapolation to real account archives

device.filesystem: ReFS fixed volume; SSD characteristics not verified

measurementMethod.cpu: All workload and GUI Windows Job cumulative CPU, including exited children, normalized to 20 logical processors.
measurementMethod.memory: Sum of current private working sets for every sampled workload and GUI process.
measurementMethod.percentiles: Nearest rank; cold p95 is the maximum of four new-Core/SQLite-connection queries. OS filesystem cache is not flushed.

observedPeaks.method: Peak CPU is the maximum consecutive Windows Job cumulative CPU delta / observed interval / logical processors, including exited workers. Process memory/handle peaks are observed 5-second samples, not instantaneous lifetime peaks. Summed working sets may count shared pages more than once. PID is used only for local grouping and is not published.

measurementMethod.accountingBoundary: Core, synthetic source, Rust workload harness and packaged GUI/WebView workers are included. The external Python sampler and CDP test driver are instrumentation, not product processes.

testPreservation.method: Rust lexical comparison ignores whitespace/comments but preserves every literal, token and assertion; changed bodies require semantic review.
testPreservation.semanticChanges: Three existing Rust tests retain assertions: resource operation identity; F015 exact incremental (1,2,0) plus complete job inventory; full_loop explicit credential binding and a date shift preserving two-day spacing. See report 14.16.
testPreservation.frontend: All 32 original frontend tests retained; home had 17 and now has 18, including one source-navigation addition. Current frontend total is 43.

stageGate.rule: Refuse stale inputs/documents, missing/duplicate/failed required cases, changed raw logs or package members, short/failed or inconsistent raw benchmark evidence.
stageGate.documentFinalization: Generate final report receipts and bundle after this public summary and all documents are saved; no self-referential document/bundle hash.

limitations: Real account/login/risk-control/download/live-site validation is not-run; authorization and conditions remain in USER-ACTIONS ACT-002.
Native IME/scaling/visible notification click/media decoding acceptance is not-run; ACT-003 retains the previous stable package and synthetic acceptance profile.
Live chat is bounded optional recent-history sampling, not complete WebSocket history. External subtitles depend on source HLS tracks.
DRM, unknown encryption, unknown response structures and missing required resources are explicitly incomplete or unsupported, never silently complete.
The workload and upstream site peers are synthetic; package GUI is the actual shipped local executable. No extrapolation to real account archives.
Recovery latency is complete Core teardown/reopen with unfinished jobs, not a claim of OS crash latency. Crash windows are covered by separate fault tests; sleep uses a synthetic clock jump.
Five-second sampled peaks do not measure instantaneous peaks between samples.
Other operating systems, installer, signing and public distribution are not validated. No push, PR, merge, release, subagents or cross-chat messages were performed.
reportReceiptScope: Final report receipts are generated after all public documents and this summary, then checked by the complete local bundle.
